purpose: This is a special multivitamin made for women who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It provides important vitamins and minerals that support the healthy growth and development of your baby. It also helps prevent nutritional deficiencies that are common during pregnancy, especially iron-deficiency anemia.
how_it_works: This supplement gives your body a combination of vitamins and minerals it needs in higher amounts during pregnancy. The iron (ferrous) helps your blood carry oxygen to both you and your baby. Folic acid in the formula is especially important because it helps prevent serious birth defects of the brain and spine in early pregnancy.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects are related to the iron, including nausea, upset stomach, constipation, and dark or black-colored stools. Taking it with food can help reduce stomach upset. Drinking plenty of water and eating fiber-rich foods can help with constipation.
warnings: Keep this medication out of reach of children — iron overdose can be very dangerous for young kids. Tell your doctor about all other medications and supplements you take, as iron can interfere with some medicines like antacids and certain antibiotics. Do not take more than the recommended dose. If you have any allergies or medical conditions like kidney disease, talk to your doctor before starting.
typical_dosing: The typical dose is one tablet or capsule taken by mouth once a day. It is best taken with a small amount of food to reduce stomach upset, but avoid taking it with dairy products, caffeine, or antacids as these can reduce iron absorption. Always follow your doctor's or the label's specific instructions.
